user.title: Add a racket
user.description: Add a racket to track its restring history. To fill in its specs automatically, type its brand and model under **Look up**.

data_description.name: A name to tell this racket apart, e.g. "Pure Aero #1".
data_description.lookup: Optional. Search the Racqix racket dataset, e.g. "pure aero 2023" or "blade 98 16x19".

play.name: Play and tension loss (optional)
play.description: Set how much you play this racket to estimate its current tension. Strings lose tension at once, then a little more every time their age multiplies by 10, and with play: most in the first hours. Leave the rates empty to use the string type's defaults, or measure your tension and run **Calibrate tension estimate**.

data.first_hour_loss: Loss in the first hour of play

data_description.hours_per_week: Average, e.g. 4. Use 0 for a spare racket.
data_description.string_type: Sets the default rates. Polyester if empty. For a hybrid, pick the mains.
data_description.initial_tension_loss: Lost in the first day after stringing. Default: polyester 10%, nylon 6%, gut 4%.
data_description.first_hour_loss: Lost in the first hour of play; each doubling of the hours played loses the same again. Default: polyester 3%, nylon 1.5%, gut 1%.
data_description.relaxation_loss: Lost, played or not, each time the strings' age multiplies by 10 (1 → 10 → 100 days). Default: polyester 4%, nylon 2%, gut 1.5%.

due.name: Restring reminder (optional)
due.description: When the strings are due. The earliest rule wins. Hours of play and estimated tension need hours of play per week.

data.min_tension: Restring when estimated tension drops to

data_description.min_tension: In this racket's tension unit, e.g. 44.

setup.name: Usual setup (optional)
setup.description: Your usual string job. **Restring with usual setup** logs it in one tap; without it, the last restring is repeated.

data_description.cross_string: Hybrids only. Defaults to the main string.

specs.name: Specs (optional)
specs.description: Values you measured yourself. These override any looked-up values.

data_description.strung_weight: Grams, with strings, grip and dampener as you play it.
data_description.balance: Millimetres from the butt cap (e.g. 320 mm).

pick.title: Pick your racket
pick.description: {count} rackets match "{query}" in the {dataset}. Their unstrung weight, balance, swingweight and stiffness become spec sensors; anything you measure yourself overrides them. Leave empty to skip.

reconfigure.title: Rename racket
reconfigure.description: Entity IDs keep their current names.

error.tension_range: Minimum tension must not be above the maximum.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the racket dataset. Try again later, or leave Look up empty.
error.no_match: No racket matches that. Try fewer words, e.g. just the model.
error.due_needs_play: Set hours of play per week to restring after hours of play or by estimated tension.
error.setup_incomplete: The usual setup needs at least a main string and a main tension.

add_restring.name: Add restring
add_restring.description: Log a new restring for a racket.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the restring. Defaults to today.

main_string.name: Main string
main_string.description: String used for the mains (or full bed).

cross_string.name: Cross string
cross_string.description: String used for the crosses, if hybrid. Defaults to the main string.

cross_tension.name: Cross tension
cross_tension.description: Tension of the crosses. Defaults to the main tension.

rating.name: Rating
rating.description: How much you liked this setup, 1–5.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: What you liked or didn't like.

image.name: Photo
image.description: A photo of the racket with this string job. Pick or upload one in My media.

repeat_restring.name: Repeat restring
repeat_restring.description: Log a restring with the racket's usual setup, or the same strings and tensions as a past restring (the latest if it has no usual setup).

restring_id.name: Copy restring
restring_id.description: ID of a past restring to copy. Leave empty for the usual setup.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the restring. Defaults to today.

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: What the restring cost, if different.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: What you liked or didn't like.

image.name: Photo
image.description: A photo of the racket with this string job. Pick or upload one in My media.

calibrate_tension.name: Calibrate tension estimate
calibrate_tension.description: Enter a tension you measured on the current strings (mains, e.g. with a stringbed tension meter or app). The racket's tension loss rates are scaled so the estimate matches it.

tension.name: Measured tension
tension.description: Mains tension you measured, in the racket's tension unit.

date.name: Date
date.description: When you measured it. Defaults to today.

update_restring.name: Update restring
update_restring.description: Change a logged restring, e.g. add notes or a rating after playing. Updates the latest restring if no ID is given.

restring_id.name: Restring ID
restring_id.description: ID of the restring to change. Leave empty for the latest one.

rating.name: Rating
rating.description: How much you liked this setup, 1–5.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: What you liked or didn't like.

image.name: Photo
image.description: Add or replace the photo for this restring.

remove_image.name: Remove photo
remove_image.description: Delete the photo for this restring.

delete_restring.name: Delete restring
delete_restring.description: Remove a restring from a racket's history.

restring_id.name: Restring ID
restring_id.description: ID of the restring to delete.

get_history.name: Get history
get_history.description: Return the full restring history of a racket.
